FEAT-5-S112.title: Tool Allowlist Schema and Registry Contract
FEAT-5-S112.description: Define a formal allowlist registry structure and Pydantic-backed contract for tool definitions, including name, input model, and execution binding to ensure consistent validation and dispatch.

FEAT-5-S113.title: Anthropic Tool Use Parsing and Dispatch Loop
FEAT-5-S113.description: Implement parsing of Anthropic tool_use blocks and map them to allowlisted tools, enforcing validation and routing to the correct execution handler.

FEAT-5-S114.title: FastAPI Integration for Tool Routing
FEAT-5-S114.description: Integrate tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool calls are executed within the agent loop and responses are properly returned to the chat frontend.

FEAT-5-S115.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Tool Router
FEAT-5-S115.description: Expand unit and integration test coverage for allowlist enforcement, validation handling, tool dispatch correctness, and failure scenarios.

FEAT-5-S116.title: Facade Integration for Tool Execution
FEAT-5-S116.description: Connect tool router dispatch outputs to application facades (Find Care, Evaluate Care, Shared services), ensuring correct service invocation per tool.
